platform: NoCopyrightSounds (NCS) Official LabelRadar Demo Submission Route
manual_review_reason: NCS explicitly directs demo submissions to its LabelRadar portal, but the portal loads dynamically and creates an account, login, terms, privacy, submission-credit and possible optional-payment boundary. A human must authenticate through the authorized portal, inspect the current campaign status, pricing, submission limits, rights and consent terms, verify that the selected MarcsMusic track fits NCS's electronic catalogue, and submit manually. NCS's general-enquiry route must not be repurposed for demo delivery.

platform: UKF / Pilot First-Party Bass Music Demo Form Route
manual_review_reason: UKF explicitly invites tracks for release on UKF or Pilot through the first-party form, but the live form fields, accepted link or file formats, upload limits, rights declarations, privacy consent and any runtime anti-spam controls were not exposed in passive rendering. A human must inspect the current form, choose the appropriate UKF or Pilot fit, verify ownership and release status, approve all metadata and terms, and submit manually. UKF explicitly says demos must not be sent to its support address.

platform: Gravitas Recordings First-Party Unreleased Demo Submission Form Route
manual_review_reason: Gravitas accepts unreleased music through its first-party form and prefers a mastered private SoundCloud playlist share link, but submission requires artist and personal contact details, disclosure of whether the music was sent to other labels, an artist statement, optional social profiles and acceptance of any live privacy or anti-spam controls. A human must verify the tracks are unreleased and mastered, confirm the SoundCloud share permissions, review all current consent and rights text, decide whether simultaneous label submissions are acceptable, approve personal data and submit manually.
